title: Great Southwest Equestrian Center
specs: 65 acres with six barns and 650 permanent stalls
Three covered arenas and four outdoor arenas with world-class footing
blurb: Great Southwest Equestrian Center hosts prestigious horse shows with 70,000 class entries annually, featuring various breeds and disciplines. The facility spans 65 acres with six barns, 650 permanent stalls, and space for 500 temporary stalls. It includes three covered arenas, three covered warm-up rings, two lunging pads, and four outdoor arenas with world-class footing.
